stale: The file changed outside the form. The form reread it: repeat the edit.
problemsNote_one: The version manifests have {{count}} loader or schema finding. The form will not add new ones; existing ones are in Problems.
problemsNote_other: The version manifests have {{count}} loader or schema findings. The form will not add new ones; existing ones are in Problems.

idProblem.format: Latin letters, digits and “_” only; starts with a letter

idHint.key: Latin letters, digits and “_”. Templates print the field as project.meta.<key>.
idHint.id: Latin letters, digits, “_” and a single “-”.

groups.title: Field groups
groups.lead: The order of groups is the order in the project settings.
groups.empty: No groups: fields come as one list.
groups.inUse: The group has fields: move them first
groups.label: Group label
groups.sectionHint: Where the group shows in the project settings.

fields.title: Project fields
fields.lead: What a student fills in the project wizard and settings. On the right: a sample of the field and the documents that print it.
fields.scopeHint: In a team project each author has their own author field.
fields.label: Label
fields.autoHint: Filled in on creation if the field is empty.
fields.autoAcademicYear: End year of the academic year
fields.kindsHint: Both checked: the field is in every kind of work.
fields.renamePerson: A project person lives in its own field: the key stays
fields.samplePerson: The person is chosen on the supervisors step: name, position, HSE or company.
fields.unused: The field is not printed anywhere. Check that it is needed.
fields.unusedRequired: The field is required on creation but is not printed anywhere.
fields.renameLead: The key changes in the manifest and in every template of the version (project.meta.<key>). For projects on older versions this removes one field and adds another: the new version is at least minor.
fields.deleteLead: The field leaves the version manifest. Templates that print it stay as they are.
fields.deletePrinted: The field prints in: {{docs}}. After deletion it will be empty there.

forms.title: Forms
forms.lead: Forms a student fills in the project, such as the AI usage declaration.
forms.requiredForPackHint: An unfilled form gives a warning when the pack is built.
forms.perAuthorHint: In a team project every author fills the form.
forms.outputTemplateHint: Path from the version folder, for example files/ai-usage/form.md.
forms.widgetHint: radio and chips for lists, slider for a number.
forms.visibleIfHint: The field shows only if another field of the form has the value.

readOnly: This version is released: its files are read-only. Edits go into a new template version.

documents.title: Version documents
documents.lead: The roster order is the order in a project. A navigation group draws a subheading in the document list.
documents.idHint: This is the folder name files/<id>/. Latin letters, digits, “_” and a single “-”.
documents.sourceHint: A blank document or a copy of a document from the packs of this workspace (latest template version).
documents.groupHint: A group unknown to the Studio shows as “Other”.
documents.removeLead: The roster entry goes away and the document folder with all its files is deleted. For projects this removes a document: the new version is at least minor.
documents.referenced: The version manifest mentions the document. After deletion fix these places, Problems will show them:

languages.title: Version languages
languages.lead: File suffix codes: report.ru.tex, report.en.tex. The first language is the default: its edition is the source of translations and is used when a translation is missing.
languages.undeclared: The manifest has no langs key: the version is in Russian. Adding a language writes langs explicitly.
languages.lastOne: At least one language is needed
languages.inUse: Files use this code: remove them first
languages.filesLead: A file without a code serves all languages. Create translation copies the default edition; translate the text in the editor.
languages.mixed: The file exists both without and with codes: the linter treats this as an error
languages.splitHint: The file becomes the “{{lang}}” edition and gets a copy to translate
languages.translateHint: A copy of the “{{from}}” edition for every file without a “{{lang}}” translation
languages.translateNone: Every file with editions already has a “{{lang}}” translation
languages.noSources: The document folder has no sources.

doc.title: Document {{id}}
doc.lead: The doc.yaml manifest of the document folder.
doc.notInRoster: The document {{id}} is not in the version roster: no form, edit the Source.
doc.name: Name
doc.gostRefHint: A checks file of the version (checks/<name>.yaml).
doc.scopeHint: In a team project each author has their own personal document.
doc.requiredHint: Without it the project is not ready for submission.
doc.langsHint: Empty: the document exists in every version language.
doc.variantsLead: Other formats of the same document: PowerPoint, HTML, Beamer.
doc.engineHint: none: the variant is not built with TeX.
doc.variantLangsHint: Empty: the variant exists in every language.
